name: append_variables
description: Add environment variables to a 1Password Environment.

accountId.description: The ID of the account the Environment belongs to

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment to update variables in

variables.description: The variables to add to the Environment

VariableInput.description: A single environment variable to set.

name.description: The name of the environment variable (e.g. ACME_API_KEY)

value.description: The value of the environment variable

concealed.description: Whether the value should be concealed when displayed

name: authenticate
description: Authenticate with the 1Password desktop app to access 1Password Environment tools.

name: create_environment
description: Create a new 1Password Environment in a specified account.

accountId.description: The ID of the account to create the Environment in

environmentName.description: The name for the new Environment

name: create_local_env_file
description: Create a locally mounted .env file for a 1Password Environment.

accountId.description: The ID of the account the Environment belongs to

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment to create the local .env file in

mountPath.description: The file system path where the .env file should be mounted

name: list_environments
description: List all 1Password Environments in a specified account.

accountId.description: The ID of the account to list Environments for

name: list_local_env_files
description: List all locally mounted .env files from a 1Password Environment.

accountId.description: The ID of the account the Environment belongs to

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment to list local .env files for

name: list_variables
description: Retrieve a list of environment variable names stored in a 1Password Environment.

accountId.description: The ID of the account the Environment belongs to

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment to list variables for

name: rename_environment
description: Rename a 1Password Environment in a specified account.

accountId.description: The ID of the account the Environment belongs to

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment to rename

environmentName.description: The new name for the Environment
